Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
agzocgud wrote:
>
> Can you combine these cards:
>
> Rötschrek and Decapitate?

No. Cannot play combat cards after combat. Rötschrek ends combat.

> The Kiss of Ra and Decapitate?

No. Need combat to play combat cards.

> Theft of Vitae and Taste of Vitae?

Sure, but Taste won't count the stolen blood. See the online card text.

> Can you choose a tap effect on a vampire by using a wwef ? (Marciana
> Giovanni, Mariel)

No. WWeF grants "block" and "reaction cards", not "special ability".

> If your intercept from 2nd trad isn´t enough, can you choose to
> deflect the bleed?

Sure.

> Do you discard both cards at the same time with Ulugh-Bek´s ability?

No.

I don't know if it has been reprinted with the updated text but is has been
errataed to say blood lost from damage. So blood spent to pay costs or blood
burnt doesn't count.

Taste of Vitae
"Only usable after strike resolution. This vampire gains an amount of blood
equal to the amount lost by the opposing vampire to damage during this round
of combat. Not usable by a vampire going into torpor. Blood loss counted by
a previous Taste of Vitae is not counted again."
